regions.region: page 1 title, author block, article metadata, keywords, and abstract
regions.finding: Verified the article title and aggregate metal-free three-component allenoic-amide/sulfur-dioxide/aryldiazonium transformation. The abstract is a reaction-class summary without experiment-specific charges or yields and is linked to the current general scheme rather than counted as another run.

regions.region: page 1 left-column introduction and cited copper O-acyl-oxime/azirine example
regions.finding: Classified the copper-catalyzed O-acyl-oxime/DABCO·(SO2)2/2H-azirine route to beta-sulfonyl enamines as prior literature. Its qualitative yield/selectivity summary is retained, but it is not a present-paper experiment.

regions.region: page 1 right-column cited diazonium/DABCO·(SO2)2 radical chemistry and current design prose
regions.finding: Separated cited arylsulfonyl-radical generation from the authors' current generic Scheme 1 design. The expected allylic radical/cation sequence is conceptual here and is represented as mechanism only when Scheme 3 appears on pages 2-3.

unresolved: Page-1 generic and cited structures contain R groups or unspecified catalysts and do not define complete unique experiments.
The abstract's moderate-to-good yield/selectivity descriptions have no per-product numerical values.
No workspace Supporting Information association is established.

regions.finding: Classified the displayed generic allenoic-amide/aryldiazonium/DABCO·(SO2)2 transformation and aryl-radical/SO2 design as the current general scheme, not an optimized or scope experiment with its own yield.

regions.region: page 2 left-column optimization prose and lower-left Table 1 entries 1-14 with footnotes a-d
regions.finding: Recorded all fourteen optimization rows independently with exact shared 1a/2a/DABCO·(SO2)2 charges, 2.0 mL solvent, N2/12 h, row solvent/copper/temperature, isolated yields, trace outcomes, and footnote Na2S2O5/K2S2O5 doses. Entry 13 is merged with Scheme 2 product 3a because both report the same DCE/35 °C/N2/12 h/82% standard run.

regions.region: page 2 left-column post-Table-1 metabisulfite replacement sentence
regions.finding: Recorded separate sodium- and potassium-metabisulfite replacement tests with the shared source bound <10%. They remain distinct from Table 1 entries 9/10, whose footnotes put 0.3 mmol metabisulfite in the shared DABCO·(SO2)2 condition at 60 °C. Exact replacement-test operating conditions are not printed.

regions.region: page 2 right-column Scheme 2 reaction header, product grid 3a-3r/3t, caption, and scope prose
regions.finding: Recorded every displayed scope arrow/product: standard 3a plus eighteen additional products 3b-3r and 3t. DCE/35 °C/N2/12 h, isolated yields, and yield basis are structured; exact scope charges omitted from the figure were not propagated from the model table. Product labels/aryl substitution positions were read from the original rendered image.

regions.region: page 2 right-column TEMPO control and beginning of Scheme 3 discussion
regions.finding: Recorded one TEMPO control under the explicitly referenced standard conditions; reaction was completely hampered and no numerical yield/adduct was reported. The following radical/cation sequence begins the proposed Scheme 3 mechanism and is not a set of isolated preparations.

unresolved: Table-footnote/prose nuance remains explicit: entries 9/10 say metabisulfite is present under shared conditions, while later prose separately describes metabisulfite replacing DABCO·(SO2)2 and gives only <10%.
Scheme 2 does not restate exact reactant/reagent charges, solvent volume, workup, purification, or product masses.
TEMPO amount, numerical control yield/conversion, detection limit, and trapped-adduct identity are not reported.
Complex scope structures remain machine-unverified; safe complete SMILES were not assigned where the compact drawing/numbering was uncertain.

regions.finding: Recorded one plausible mechanism with ordered proposed SET, SO2 trapping, central-allene radical addition, oxidative SET, and intramolecular cyclization steps. A/B and radical/cation species are proposed intermediates, not isolated reaction records.

regions.region: page 3 left-column mechanism continuation and conclusion
regions.finding: The prose completes the Scheme 3 interpretation and restates the aggregate current transformation; it supplies no additional experiment, charge, condition, or product-specific yield beyond page 2.

regions.region: page 3 left-column declarations/acknowledgments and right-column Appendix A/References 1-9
regions.finding: Administrative, online-SI availability, and bibliography content only. The online supplementary-material statement does not establish workspace SI association, and cited external papers were not imported as current-paper experiments.

unresolved: Scheme 3 intermediates are proposed and not independently observed or quantified.
The publisher's online supplementary-material statement does not establish an associated workspace SI file.
No current-paper reaction experiment or existing-record enrichment occurs in the reference list.
